sources.usage: Project brief, enums, allowed design space, ranges, and schemas.
Public/cleared/provisional source usability registry; distinguishes formal-ready, background-only, provisional-only, and needs-review materials.
Agent-readable navigation layer for scopes, required tasks, source-use boundaries, and missing-data checklist; not a new authority source.
Submitted site boundary geometry source (provisional). Not an official redline; full recomputation required once official polygons are released.
Three required detailed-design key area boundaries (provisional).
Official announcement tasks, scope levels, key areas, language, and deliverable context.
Agent-facing open-call principles, six required agent tasks, scenario/branding/operation requirements, and boundary clause.

sources.publisher_zh: 北京市人民代表大会常务委员会（首都之窗发布）
sources.usage: Statutory basis for industrial-category urban renewal: underused-building renewal duties (Art.35), permitted use conversion of existing buildings, rail-station-area integrated renewal. Used to anchor the open ledger mechanism in existing law.
sources.limitation: Cited as published legal text; project-specific applicability still requires professional legal confirmation.

sources.title_zh: 老旧低效楼宇更新实施办法（试行）
sources.publisher_zh: 北京市住房和城乡建设委员会等三部门
sources.usage: Existing policy instrument that already requires a base ledger (基础台账) and project library for underused buildings, owner-initiated registration, and co-renewal of surrounding leftover spaces. The proposal's open ledger operationalizes this instrument; it does not invent a new statutory tool.
sources.limitation: Trial measure; specific project eligibility and procedures require confirmation by the competent authorities.

sources.title_zh: 老旧低效楼宇更新技术导则（试行）
sources.publisher_zh: 北京市住房和城乡建设委员会
sources.usage: Technical guideline reference (issued 2024-03-18) for underused-building renewal; cited as the professional depth baseline that pilot retrofits must follow.
sources.limitation: Referenced at title/notice level; full technical clauses to be applied by professional teams during deepening.

sources.title_zh: 中关村科学城加快建设具有全球影响力人工智能产业高地的若干措施
sources.usage: Existing factor-support policies (compute subsidies, scenario-opening funds, model vouchers) that the wake ledger can plug into as demand-side signals for space matching.
sources.limitation: Policy amounts and eligibility are quoted from the published text; no new funding commitment is implied for this proposal.

sources.title_zh: “三区两翼”打造世界级AI集聚地（京报网）
sources.usage: Reported industry context: 2,000+ AI enterprises, 130 registered LLMs, RMB 350B+ core AI industry scale in Haidian; belt hosts 70%+ of district AI enterprises/revenue/financing and 80%+ of talent; reported ~10M sqm industrial space with ~1M sqm renewable space along the belt.
sources.limitation: Media-reported figures (报道口径), not audited statistics or an approved ledger; used as context and target framing only, marked low confidence in metrics.

sources.title_zh: 京张铁路遗址公园二期建成 打造9公里复合型城市遗址绿廊（新京报）
sources.usage: Reported completion of the 9 km heritage park (opened 2026-08-06): ~53 ha, serving ~70 communities and ~450k residents, continuous three-lane slow mobility, 9 reopened side streets, welded-rail factory gantry crane landscape node, 3rd-Ring terrace. Basis for treating the park as a built interface rather than a design object.
sources.limitation: Park alignment in this package is an indicative band, not the surveyed park boundary; media figures are reporting-level facts.

sources.title_zh: 惊艳！海淀大钟寺中坤广场“蝶变”（北京日报）
sources.usage: Local proof case: Zhongkun Plaza (Dazhongsi) whole-building regeneration — 2008 opening, prolonged distress, 2018 acceleration, 2020 retrofit start with metro-integrated sunken plaza, conversion to high-tech office; also documents Haidian's rolling reserve library for old-building renewal.
sources.limitation: Case facts at media-report level; ownership and financial details not used as formal claims.

sources.title_zh: 北京老旧商业体变身城市新空间（武汉晚报转载报道，大钟寺1733）
sources.usage: Local proof case: Dazhongsi 1733 open commercial district (opened 2023-12) created from the long-idle commercial podium, preserving structure and integrating temple heritage elements; cited for the open, low-threshold operating model.
sources.limitation: Secondary media report; used for mechanism description only.

sources.title_zh: “模速空间”的空间还在不断“生长”（上海市规划和自然资源局）
sources.publisher_zh: 上海市规划和自然资源局
sources.usage: Benchmark case: Shanghai Mosu Space LLM ecosystem community grown inside existing high-quality building stock with mixed-use planning and fast-track review; mechanism reference for the quick-fit wake mode.
sources.limitation: Mechanism comparison only; Shanghai indicators are not imported as targets for this site.

sources.title_zh: 总书记考察的上海“模速空间”，是一个怎样的空间？（上海国际人才网）
sources.usage: Reported detail that the first 13k sqm of Mosu Space was converted from shell space to move-in-ready incubation space in 38 days; used as a speed benchmark for quick-fit retrofit of existing stock.
sources.limitation: Reported figure; not a commitment that the same speed is achievable in this district.

sources.title_zh: 传统军工企业基地转型升级的768探索（中国经济网）
sources.usage: Local proof case: 768 Creative Industrial Park (Xueyuan Rd 5) — 1950s radio factory converted since 2009-2011 under a preserve-first, no-demolition principle into a design/tech park; mechanism reference for courtyard wake mode.

sources.title_zh: 石油大院治好“大院病”（首都之窗）
sources.publisher_zh: 北京市人民政府门户网站
sources.usage: Local proof case: Xueyuan Rd 20 Petroleum Compound — multi-owner compound governance, clearing idle sheds into ~8,000 sqm shared civic space ('six spaces, one station'); mechanism reference for courtyard wake mode and multi-owner coordination.
sources.limitation: Case facts at government-news level; not a template that transfers ownership arrangements.

sources.usage: Global case: a 1920s rail freight hall converted into a large startup campus; mechanism reference for heritage-rail reuse as innovation infrastructure.
sources.limitation: Mechanism comparison only; scale, rents, and governance are not imported.

sources.usage: Global case: rail-land regeneration combining heritage structures (Coal Drops Yard, granary) with tech anchor tenants and continuous public realm; mechanism reference for station-adjacent stock reuse.

Global case: an aging industrial block scheduled for demolition retained and programmed into a dense startup cluster with public agency + university operation; mechanism reference for low-cost stock as ecosystem seedbed.

sources.title_en: Newlab at Brooklyn Navy Yard, New York
sources.usage: Global case: a former shipbuilding machine shop converted into a deep-tech prototyping hub with shared fabrication; mechanism reference for high-bay stock as embodied-AI pilot space.
Global case: heritage hospital buildings extended into an urban innovation district linking university medicine, startups, and capital; mechanism reference for institution-edge stock activation.
